mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO pos_sale_item (sale_id, line_no, material_id, unit, unit_ratio, input_qty, qty, list_price, price, price_source, special_id, discount_rate, sale_price, amount, order_share, final_amount, tax_rate, serial_nos, orig_item_id, returned_qty, returned_amount, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{i.saleId}, #{i.lineNo}, #{i.materialId}, #{i.unit}, #{i.unitRatio}, #{i.inputQty}, #{i.qty}, #{i.listPrice}, #{i.price}, #{i.priceSource}, #{i.specialId}, #{i.discountRate}, #{i.salePrice}, #{i.amount}, #{i.orderShare}, #{i.finalAmount}, #{i.taxRate}, #{i.serialNos}, #{i.origItemId}, 0, 0, #{i.remark}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT i.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.barcode, sp.name AS special_name FROM pos_sale_item i JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id LEFT JOIN pos_special sp ON sp.id = i.special_id WHERE i.sale_id = #{saleId} ORDER BY i.line_no
mapper.update: UPDATE pos_sale_item SET returned_qty = returned_qty + #{qty}, returned_amount = returned_amount + #{amount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND input_qty - returned_qty >= #{qty}
